To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) near-memory processing provides significant speedup for important data intensive applications; (2) near-memory processing can be implemented using the same accelerators used for off-chip accelerators; and (3) near-memory processing consumes less energy than off-chip processing.
for data intensive applications, near-memory accelerations are 3x- 13x faster and consume 7%- 39% less energy compared to accelerators placed external to the 3D memory stack.
near-memory accelerators can provide significant speedup and energy savings over accelerators that are external to a 3D memory module.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of specialized processing elements at the memory layer of a 2.5D/3D stacked memory architecture.
the design of a specialized processor that takes advantage of a 3-D memory stack.
the design of a near-memory accelerator for data intensive applications.

near-memory accelerators provide a better performance per watt compared to external accelerators.

, for important kernels, near-memory processing provides significant speedup and energy reduction over a general purpose processor, and the benefits are comparable to those of external accelerators.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
near-memory accelerators provide comparable performance to external accelerators but with significantly reduced energy consumption and area.
near-memory accelerators provide significant speedup and energy savings compared to external accelerators for a variety of data intensive applications.

, in addition to the benefits of near-memory processing, accelerators that are external to the memory module can also provide significant benefits for data intensive operations, but at the expense of increased area and energy.

the performance and energy benefits of near-memory processing can be significant and that these benefits are more pronounced for applications with a large memory footprint.
